---

## 2. Two analysis tracks (they do not join to each other)

**Track A — aggregated** (datasets 1–7): already summarised by geography / period / age / sex.
Feeds KPIs, maps, comparisons, and the dashboard.
Shared join key: **`GEO` + `REF_DATE`** (+ `Age group` + `Sex`/`Gender` where present).

**Track B — microdata** (dataset 8, MHACS): one row per survey respondent, ~600 coded variables.
The only dataset that supports regression / feature-importance / ML on individual-level factors.
Uses survey weight `WTS_M`.

The **synthetic Kaggle set** (Danny) is a *methods sandbox* only — it is not Canadian and not real,
so any model built on it is a demonstration of technique, never a finding about mental health.

---

## 3. The main constraint: time coverage

| Dataset | Periods | Trend line possible? |
|---|---|---|
| `perceived_mh_annual` | 3 (2019/20, 21/22, 23/24) | Weak — best available |
| `perceived_health_quarterly` | 10 quarters | Yes, but it is *general* perceived health, not mental health |
| `suicidal_thoughts` | 2 (2015, 2019) | No |
| `stress_coping` | 2 (2016, 2019) | No |
| `cchs_mh_disorders` | 3 (2002, 2012, 2022) | No — point comparison only |
| `cihi_children_youth` | 6 fiscal years | Yes — children/youth only |

➡️ **A single Canada-wide "mental health over time" line chart is not well supported.**
Team decision needed: (a) reframe the dashboard around *cycle-to-cycle change* and
*province-vs-province* comparison, or (b) pull one long annual series via the StatCan
Web Data Service API (e.g. self-rated mental health, or self-harm deaths from table 13-10-0392).

## 4. Dataset detail

### 1. `perceived_mh_annual` — StatCan 13-10-0972 (Misa)
- **Source:** https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=1310097201
- **Content:** CCHS two-year-period estimates. 8 indicators: perceived mental health (very good/excellent; fair/poor), perceived life stress, mood disorder, anxiety disorder, heavy drinking, cannabis use (12 mo), sense of belonging to local community.
- **Dimensions:** 13 provinces + territories · Sex (Both / Males / Females) · Age = "Total, 18 years and over" only.
- **Quality:** cleanest table. ~2.8% of `VALUE` rows suppressed (`E`/`F`/`..`). All values are percentages.
- **Use:** headline KPI cards; province comparison; the (short) trend view.

### 2. `suicidal_thoughts` — StatCan 13-10-0465 subset (Fatima)
- **Content:** 3 indicators — *suicidal thoughts (15 years and over)*, *consultation with a health professional about emotional/mental health*, *positive mental health (flourishing)*.
- **Dimensions:** 11 provinces · Sex · 6 age groups (12–17, 18–34, 35–49, 50–64, 65+, total 12+).
- **Quality:** 2015 & 2019 only — **no post-COVID data**. ~6.9% `VALUE` suppressed. Both counts and percentages present.
- **Use:** the suicide-ideation angle; age-group breakdown; pre-pandemic baseline.

### 3. `stress_coping` — StatCan 13-10-0802 (Fatima)
- **Content:** 10 indicators — ability to handle day-to-day demands / unexpected problems (good or excellent); main source of stress (work, finances, family, school work 12–34, time pressure, health, other, none).
- **Dimensions:** 11 provinces · Sex · 6 age groups.
- **Quality:** 2016 & 2019 only. ~18.9% `VALUE` suppressed (many small cells).
- **Use:** "sources of stress" supporting analysis; not a core outcome.

### 4. `perceived_health_quarterly` — StatCan 45-10-0081 (Fatima)
- ⚠️ **Filename `Catalogue Entry Mental health indicators.csv` is misleading.** The data is *general* perceived health (excellent or very good / good / fair or poor), **not mental health**.
- **Dimensions:** 13 geographies · Gender (Men / Women / Total) · quarterly 2021-04 → 2023-07.
- **Use:** context / control series only. Consider dropping, or relabel clearly.

### 5. `cchs_mh_disorders` — StatCan 13-10-0465, CCHS Mental Health (Fatima)
- ⚠️ Filename `Catalogue Entry Perceived health, by gender and province.csv` — actual content is **diagnosed mental & substance-use disorders**.
- **Content:** 45 indicators — any mood disorder, any anxiety disorder, bipolar, generalized anxiety, social phobia, alcohol/cannabis/drug abuse or dependence, suicidal thoughts (life / 12 months), etc., each as "life" and "12 months".
- **Dimensions:** 13 geographies · Gender · 6 age groups · Number and Percent.
- **Quality:** cycles **2002, 2012, 2022** only. **38.5% of `VALUE` rows suppressed.** Includes a coefficient-of-variation field and a "statistically different from previous period" flag.
- **Use:** a 2012 → 2022 change comparison; prevalence by disorder. **Not** a trend line.

### 6. `cihi_mh_services` — CIHI / PHAC Health Infobase (Fatima)
- **Content:** 29 indicators (self-rated mental health, mood/anxiety disorders, perceived need for care, self-inflicted injury ED visits & hospitalisations, mortality, life satisfaction, etc.).
- ⚠️ **Not tidy data.** Each row is a *chart definition*: `indicator`, `vis_option` (Age/Sex), `x_axis_values`, `y_axis_values`, `confidence_interval_low/high`.
- **Action required:** unpivot in `02_data_cleaning.ipynb` into `(indicator, breakdown, group, value, ci_low, ci_high)`.

### 7. `cihi_children_youth` — CIHI workbook (Fatima)
- **Content:** ED visits, hospitalisations, physician visits, dispensed psychotropic medications for children & youth (5–17), by province, age, sex, diagnosis category. Fiscal years 2018/19 → 2023/24.
- ⚠️ **32 sheets**, most are formatted report tables with title rows and merged cells. The machine-readable data is on the hidden sheets **`Table8DATA_to hide`** (ED) and **`Table13DATA_to hide`** (hospitalisations).
- **Action required:** parse those two sheets into tidy CSVs; ignore the rest.

### 8. `mhacs_2022_pumf` — StatCan MHACS 2022 PUMF (Samir)
- **Source:** https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/n1/en/type/data?subject_levels=13#publicusemicrodata
- **Content:** 9,861 respondents, 602 variables — screening (depression, anxiety, social phobia), positive mental health, suicidality (`SUI_01/02/03`), substance use, disability/distress (K6), social support, service use & perceived need, demographics, income, education, labour.
- **Quality:** no blank cells — **missing is coded** (`6/7/8/9`, `96`, `996`, `99.6`, …). Every value is a numeric code.
- **Action required:** decode ~25 priority variables against the **PUMF Data Dictionary PDF** (`data/raw/.../Doc/EN/2022_MHACS_PUMF_Data_dictionary.pdf`) into `docs/data_dictionary.md`. Apply `WTS_M` for population estimates; use bootstrap weights (`pumf_bsw.csv`) for variance if needed.
- **Use:** Track B — "which factors are associated with poor mental health / suicidal ideation".

### — `mental_health_dataset` — Kaggle synthetic (Danny)
- 10,000 synthetic individuals; columns: age, gender, employment_status, work_environment, mental_health_history, seeks_treatment, stress_level, sleep_hours, physical_activity_days, depression_score, anxiety_score, social_support_score, productivity_score, mental_health_risk.
- **Synthetic, global, not real.** Use only to practice the ML workflow (`notebooks/05_ml_synthetic_sandbox.ipynb`). Keep findings out of the main report.
